verified_claims: The free continuum Dirac Fourier multiplier is defined as a densely defined LinearPMap on l2(Z^3; C^4) with maximal square-summable-output domain.
Every single Fourier mode and every finite Fourier truncation belongs to the domain.
The maximal domain is dense in coefficient Hilbert space.
The multiplier is symmetric on its maximal domain.
The Hilbert adjoint acts coordinatewise by the same self-adjoint mode Hamiltonians.
The adjoint domain is contained in the maximal multiplier domain.
The multiplier equals its Hilbert adjoint and is self-adjoint.
Finite Fourier truncation commutes exactly with the multiplier.
Every domain vector has a finite truncation approximating both the vector and its operator image to arbitrary prescribed accuracy.
nonclaims: No explicit equivalence with a named Sobolev or momentum-weighted norm is proved.
No unbounded operator has yet been conjugated to physical torus L2 inside Lean.
No identification of the previously checked unitary group with the spectral exponential of this unbounded operator is claimed.
No graph-resolvent or strong-resolvent convergence theorem is claimed.
No gauge-covariant or interacting unbounded Dirac Hamiltonian is constructed.
The inherited repository default-root packaging issue is not represented as a passing gate.
